technician_note: Cust states CEL on and rough idle. P0302 stored. Found damaged ignition coil cyl 2. Replaced coil. Cleared codes. Road tested, no misfire, CEL off.

Cust states severe misfire under load. P0300, P0301, P0303, P0305 stored. Found carbon tracking on plug wires 1, 3 and 5. Replaced plug wires and spark plugs. Cleared codes. Road tested 10 miles, no misfire.
